snippet.title: Tears of Metal - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get on Steam: https://s.team/a/1913120
Discord: https://discord.gg/papercult

Fight solo or up to 4-player co-op to reclaim your island alongside your Scottish battalion. On each campaign, gain new powerful upgrades, rally your forces, and stop the invader as they carve into the Mother Stone to harvest its power.
